what: ThriveCart positions Gumroad's flat 10% transaction fee as "penaliz[ing] growth," calculating that a creator generating $50,000 annually would pay over $5,000 in platform fees alone, versus ThriveCart's one-time payment model.
verbatim_snippet: "Gumroad's flat 10% transaction fee (plus processing fees) effectively penalizes growth. For a creator generating $50,000 annually, Gumroad claims over $5,000 in platform fees alone. In contrast, platforms like ThriveCart, which offer one-time payments, cap these costs, drastically increasing net revenue retention."
notes: Published by ThriveCart, a competing platform. Competitor affiliation. ThriveCart offers a one-time license (~$495) rather than per-transaction fees.
